tools.name: query_orders
tools.description: Returns recent orders for a customer from the Orders data product. Consumers of this data product are built against a specific data-contract version; the Data Contract Version Gate policy reads the declared contract version from a request header and blocks calls built against an unsupported (too-old) contract version, while allowing deprecated versions through with a deprecation warning until their sunset date.

customerId.description: The unique identifier of the customer whose recent orders should be returned from the data product.

orderCount.description: The number of recent orders returned for the customer from the data product.

latestOrderId.description: The identifier of the customer's most recent order in the data product.
